walkthroughs.title: Pre-approved visitor at the gate
walkthroughs.description: The guard scans a visitor's pass, sees it is valid, confirms entry, and finds the visitor in the inside list.

walkthroughs.title: Delivery at the gate
walkthroughs.description: A courier arrives with a parcel. The guard records it, holds it at the gate, and marks it collected. No visitor check-in is needed.

walkthroughs.title: Resident gives a decision by phone
walkthroughs.description: The resident does not answer in the app. The guard calls, records the explicit phone decision, and then checks the visitor in.

walkthroughs.title: Visitor leaves, guard checks out
walkthroughs.description: The guard finds a visitor in the inside list, taps Check Out, confirms, and the visit closes.

walkthroughs.title: Guard starts a shift
walkthroughs.description: The guard signs in, starts the shift at Gate 1, and reviews recent gate activity.

walkthroughs.title: Unlisted visitor: guard asks, resident approves
walkthroughs.description: The guard registers a visitor and sends a request. The tour switches to the resident's phone to approve, then back to the guard to check the visitor in.

walkthroughs.title: Unlisted visitor: guard asks, resident rejects
walkthroughs.description: Same request, but the resident rejects on their phone. Back at the gate the guard sees DO NOT ALLOW ENTRY.

walkthroughs.title: Pre-approved guest: resident creates pass, guard scans it
walkthroughs.description: The resident creates and shares a pass. The tour then switches to the guard, who scans it and records entry.
